model_review.rationale: Linear regression is appropriate for continuous outcomes (ISI/PSQI) with multiple continuous predictors (connectivity metrics). Bootstrap confidence intervals enhance robustness to small sample sizes. Negative controls account for global signal confounds. The design aligns with hypothesis-driven analysis of network-specific effects.
warnings: Sample size (N=51) may limit power for detecting small effect sizes in multiple regression
DTI data referenced in analysis plan not present in available modalities (fmri/scales only)
Variable mappings require scientific validation beyond data profile alignment

model_selection_policy.reason: fMRI/QC motion covariates available (max_FD, mean_DVARS, mean_FD, percent_high_motion); linear regression controls confounding.
model_selection_policy.ml_reason: Multiple predictors are available; predictive ML regressors are eligible under the model-selection policy.
